F=$(cygpath -m {{FIX}} 2>/dev/null || echo {{FIX}}); R=$F/tdc-{{SID}}; T=$R.tmp; rm -rf $R $T; mkdir -p $R/src/A $R/tests/T $R/.claude $T && cd $R && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && printf 'v0
' > src/A/a.cs && printf 'v0
' > tests/T/aTests.cs && printf 'cat out.txt; exit 1
' > run-tests.sh && printf '{"commands":{"test":"sh run-tests.sh {suite}"}}' > .claude/kit.config.json && git add -A && git commit -qm init && export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R TMPDIR=$T && H={{KIT}}/hooks/tdd-scope-guard.sh && D={{KIT}}/hooks/bash-dispatch.sh && pay(){ jq -cn --arg t "$1" --argjson i "$2" '{hook_event_name:"PreToolUse",tool_name:$t,session_id:"s",transcript_path:"",agent_id:"c1",agent_type:"cctoolkit:tdd-cycle",tool_input:$i}'; } && why(){ o=$(jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason // empty'); o=${o:-pass}; printf '%s' "${o:0:$1}"; } && cd {{ROOT}} && printf '{"hook_event_name":"SubagentStart","session_id":"s","transcript_path":"","agent_id":"c1","agent_type":"cctoolkit:tdd-cycle"}' | bash $H && a=$(pay Write "{"file_path":"$R/tests/T/aTests.cs"}" | bash $H | why 20) && printf 'v1
' > $R/tests/T/aTests.cs && b=$(pay StructuredOutput '{"red":{"status":"RED"}}' | bash $H | why 25) && c=$(pay Bash "$(jq -cn --arg c "cctoolkit tdd-scope red <<'RED_JSON'" '{command:$c}')" | bash $D | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.updatedInput.command' | head -1) && pay Bash '{"command":"sh run-tests.sh UnitTests"}' | bash $D >/dev/null && printf 'failed A.ShouldX (1ms)
  Assert.Equal() Failure
' > $R/out.txt && printf 'v1
' > $R/src/A/a.cs && CP(){ o=$(printf '%s' "$1" | python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/tdd-scope.py red --agent c1 --transcript -); r=$?; printf '%s' "${o:0:$2}"; return $r; } && d=$(CP '{"status":"RED","exit":1,"stubs":[]}' 60; echo " exit=$?") && RED='{"status":"RED","exit":1,"stubs":["src/A/a.cs"]}' && e=$(CP "$RED" 26) && f=$(pay Edit "{"file_path":"$R/tests/T/aTests.cs"}" | bash $H | why 30) && g=$(pay Edit "{"file_path":"$R/src/A/a.cs"}" | bash $H | why 20) && printf 'v2
' > $R/src/A/a.cs && h=$(pay StructuredOutput "{"red":{"status":"RED","exit":0,"stubs":[]},"green":{"status":"GREEN"}}" | bash $H | why 30) && i=$(pay StructuredOutput "{"red":$RED,"green":{"status":"GREEN"}}" | bash $H | why 20) && printf 'v2
' > $R/tests/T/aTests.cs && k=$(pay StructuredOutput "{"red":$RED,"green":{"status":"GREEN"}}" | bash $H | why 62) && l=$(python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/tdd-scope.py evidence | grep test-edit) && echo "$a|$b|$c|$d|$e|$f|$g|$h|$i|$k|$l"

expect.stdout: pass|No RED checkpoint yet: ru|cctoolkit tdd-scope red --agent c1 --transcript - <<'RED_JSON'|RED checkpoint refused: The tree shows source files changed  exit=1|RED checkpoint passed. GRE|pass|pass|`red` differs from the report |pass|pass|test-edit tests/T/aTests.cs: removed none + added none

cases.name: tdd scope: an agent working in a linked worktree of the project (run-lot's `root`) is checked on that tree — its first Edit there or Bash call opening with `cd <worktree> &&` moves its snapshot; the implementer's test Edit passes, a test changed behind its back recorded, restored through the CLI run from the worktree; a Bash write to an absolute worktree path denied; a worktree of another repository is not followed
cases.cmd:
F=$(cygpath -m {{FIX}} 2>/dev/null || echo {{FIX}}); R=$F/tdw-{{SID}}; T=$R.tmp; O=$R.other; rm -rf $R $T $O $R.ow; mkdir -p $R/src/A $R/tests/T $R/.claude $T $O/tests/T && cd $R && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && printf 'v0
' > src/A/a.cs && printf 'v0
' > tests/T/aTests.cs && printf '{"commands":{"test":"sh run-tests.sh {suite}"}}' > .claude/kit.config.json && git add -A && git commit -qm init && git worktree add -q --detach .claude/worktrees/wt && W=$R/.claude/worktrees/wt && (cd $O && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && printf 'v0
' > tests/T/aTests.cs && git add -A && git commit -qm init && git worktree add -q --detach $R.ow) && OW=$R.ow && export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R TMPDIR=$T && H={{KIT}}/hooks/tdd-scope-guard.sh && D={{KIT}}/hooks/bash-dispatch.sh && start(){ printf '{"hook_event_name":"SubagentStart","session_id":"s","transcript_path":"","agent_id":"%s","agent_type":"cctoolkit:%s"}' $1 $2 | bash $H; } && edit(){ o=$(printf '{"hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","tool_name":"Edit","session_id":"s","transcript_path":"","agent_id":"%s","agent_type":"cctoolkit:%s","tool_input":{"file_path":"%s"}}' $1 $2 $3 | bash $H | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason // empty' | cut -b1-40); echo "${o:-pass}"; } && final(){ o=$(printf '{"hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","tool_name":"StructuredOutput","session_id":"s","transcript_path":"","agent_id":"%s","agent_type":"cctoolkit:%s","tool_input":%s}' $1 $2 "$3" | bash $H | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason // empty' | grep -o 'starting with exactly: [^,]*'); echo "${o:-pass}"; } && sh_(){ o=$(jq -cn --arg c "$2" --arg a $1 '{tool_name:"Bash",session_id:"s",agent_id:$a,agent_type:"cctoolkit:tdd-test-author",transcript_path:"",tool_input:{command:$c}}' | bash $D | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision // empty'); [ "$o" = deny ] && echo deny || echo pass; } && cd {{ROOT}} && start a1 tdd-implementer && y1=$(edit a1 tdd-implementer $W/tests/T/aTests.cs) && printf 'v1
' > $W/tests/T/aTests.cs && y2=$(final a1 tdd-implementer '{"status":"GREEN","exit":0}') && (cd $W && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$W python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/tdd-scope.py restore a1 tests/T/aTests.cs >/dev/null) && y3=$(final a1 tdd-implementer '{"status":"GREEN","exit":0}') && start a2 tdd-test-author && y4=$(sh_ a2 "cd '$W' && export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR='$W' && sed -i s/v0/v9/ src/A/a.cs") && y5=$(sh_ a2 "cd '$W' && export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR='$W' && cat x > $W/src/A/a.cs") && start a3 tdd-implementer && y6=$(edit a3 tdd-implementer $OW/tests/T/aTests.cs) && echo "$y1|$y2|$y3|$(cat $W/tests/T/aTests.cs)|$y4|$y5|$y6"
